اقتحمتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمْتُنَّ (iqtaḥamtunna) /iq.ta.ħam.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمْتُنَّ (uqtuḥimtunna) /uq.tu.ħim.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
